description: This is a shell script that manages the startup, shutdown, and configuration of a DHCPv6 server service on a network device. It includes functions to generate configuration files, handle events, and maintain DUIDs, effectively acting as an init script for the DHCPv6 server service.

methods.name: prepare_dhcpv6s_config
methods.description: Generates the DHCPv6 server configuration file based on current network settings and parameters.

methods.name: restore_dhcpv6s_duid
methods.description: Restores the DHCPv6 server's DUID from NVRAM or creates it if necessary.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6 server if enabled and configured properly.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv6 server and saves relevant state to NVRAM.
